Department

Description
: Discover a unique addition to your collection with this vintage collectible tin containing an assortment of rough mineral and rock specimens. The classic metal tin, featuring charming imagery from The Saturday Evening Post dated May 7, 1932, adds nostalgic appeal and a decorative touch, making this set perfect for display as well as storage. Inside, you'll find a variety of unpolished mineral stones in assorted natural shadesearthy browns, creamy whites, rusty reds, yellows, and the occasional black or grayeach one offering its own distinctive shape, color, and surface texture. These handpicked rocks are ideal for beginner geologists, educational collections, or anyone who enjoys the raw beauty of natural minerals. The metal tin keeps everything together and displays well on shelves or desks. Please note that both the tin and the stones show typical evidence of age and handling, including small surface marks and overall wear, which only add to their authentic, timeworn character

Set of 3 Vintage Hemingray 42 and Whitall Tatum Glass Insulators
This set includes three vintage glass insulators used for telegraph or power lines. It features two Hemingray-42 insulators, one in aqua blue glass and one in clear glass, both embossed with branding and model numbers. The set also includes one Whitall Tatum Co. insulator in light blue aqua glass with embossed markings. Each insulator has ridged designs and domed tops characteristic of early to mid-20th century utility glassware. These pieces show minor wear consistent with vintage use and are suitable for collectors interested in historical or decorative items.

282075842.description: This listing includes three vintage glass insulators marked 'WHITALL TATUM No 1'. Manufactured by the Whitall Tatum company, these insulators were used for telegraph and power lines during the early to mid-20th century. The glass ranges from clear to slightly smoky in color. Each insulator measures approximately 3-4 inches in height. The items are in good vintage condition with surface wear and dirt consistent with age and outdoor use. No major cracks or chips are visible. Each piece features embossed manufacturer details on the base.
